messages:
From: Claire DuPont <claire@fintechebb.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintechebb.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor assessment

Hi Monica,

We're onboarding Redwood as a vendor for a payments integration and our compliance team needs the SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent audit period. We understand reports are gated by NDA — is that correct? If so, please share the steps and an approximate timeline for: 1) executing the NDA (our legal prefers DocuSign), and 2) receiving access to the SOC 2 Type II report (we can accept a redacted copy if that's standard).

Quick context: FinTech Ebb's procurement review window closes on 07/09, and our audit owner (cc'd security@fintechebb.com) will need the report to complete risk approval.

Also: if a bridge letter or interim attestation is available while the Type II upload is prepared, that would help.

Thanks — let me know if you need a PO or procurement contact.

Claire DuPont
Vendor Risk Lead 
FinTech Ebb
claire@fintechebb.com

--

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor assessment

Hi Claire — thanks for reaching out and for the timeline. Correct — our SOC 2 Type II is shared under NDA.

Plan and next steps:
- I can send our standard mutual NDA via DocuSign today. Once countersigned we will provide a secure, read-only copy of the SOC 2 Type II and any accompanying bridge letter if applicable.
- Typical turnaround: 24–72 hours after the NDA is fully executed. If you need a redacted/summary variant sooner we can discuss a limited extract.
- Please confirm the preferred signer for the NDA (legal or procurement) and whether a company PO is required before we deliver.

For transparency I'm cc'ing Grace from our security operations team — she'll help scope any evidence requests that might follow after your initial review.

Attachments I will include in the next message: NDA_Redwood_v3.docx and a DocuSign envelope link.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II report request for vendor assessment

Looping in a quick security note so expectations are clear.

Monica/Grounded team — we prefer to deliver a tightly redacted PDF of the SOC 2 Type II that removes client-identifying details; full control evidence sets (workpapers) require a separate intake and typically happen under a scoped audit request. If FinTech Ebb needs specific control artifacts we'll need to raise a formal evidence request with S&O and agree on handling.

Suggested language for the NDA (to avoid back-and-forth): mutual NDA, 3-year term, mutual return/deletion clause for confidential materials, and explicit permission to share SOC 2 Type II for vendor risk purposes only. I attached the current NDA we prefer.

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_v3.docx (filename stub)

Grace — can you confirm whether a bridge letter exists for the 2026 audit period and whether we have a locked PDF that can be delivered immediately after the signed NDA?

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
